items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: Illuminating the Stories of WWII: Movie Screening and Sculpture Talk
items.summary: This Remembrance Day celebrate and reflect on the history, sacrifices and personal stories of Canadian soldiers and of Dutch civilians during the liberation of the Netherlands in World War II. Come enjoy this multifaceted evening, which includes a photo display, film screening and informative talk. Five photographs by Jason Van Bruggen from the 80 Years of Freedom Exhibition will be on view during this event. There will also be a screening of the film 80 Faces of Liberation also by Jason van Bruggen.

items.title: The Great Toy Exchange
items.summary: Do you have toys you want to get rid of? Maybe you're tripping over that lego or your kids aren't playing with those dolls anymore? Join The Great Toy Exchange in Streetsville! Give gently used toys a second life and connect with your local community. The Great Toy Exchange is a neighbourhood initiative designed to keep gently-used toys out of landfills, promote sustainability, and bring local families together. Locations : Myofascial Release Mississauga (Sunday, November 8 at 10AM-1PM) The Old Credit Brewing Co.

items.title: Seasons Christmas Show 2026
items.summary: Step into a winter wonderland and kick off the holiday season at the Seasons Christmas Show 2026, taking place November 13-15 at the International Centre in Mississauga. Celebrating its 21st year, this beloved holiday tradition brings together everything that makes the season special, from festive décor and unique gifts to seasonal inspiration and family-friendly fun.

items.title: Merry Market
items.summary: Give better gifts, get them now. Join hello happy hq for their 7th annual Merry Market in Mississauga at the historic Small Arms Inspection Building. Discover a curated collection of makers, curators and small businesses at their flagship holiday event and shop small this season. Join a workshop, warm up with a coffee, and savour local bites between shopping stops! Grab your pals and spend the day with us! hello happy is hosting a food drive during this event in collaboration with Compass Food Bank.
